scope: Two frozen component diffs and12 offline tests only; public_probe under development was not read or reviewed.

reasoning.conclusion: Only exact immutable bytes640 with empty pending bypass the bytearray copy. The same raw frame enters unchanged sample/ring/normalization/VAD/onset/end/tail logic. Mutable input, memoryview, subclass, fragmented pending, empty and batch inputs retain the original path.

For any partition, either original buffering executes verbatim or the original buffer would contain exactly the immutable640-byte argument. One identical frame is processed and pending stays empty in both. No extra iteration. Done checks and batched remainder on speech_end are unchanged. Test partitions are representative, not exhaustive enumeration.

Raw reuse is safe because bytes is immutable; float32 normalization still creates the original independent samples. Mutable paths still copy before ring retention. Prefix/event/result byte checks preserve raw PCM and offsets.

Unchanged _hop returns first-hop np.empty(0,float32) or self.ola[:256].copy(). Both are independent. Returning the sole result cannot alias OLA/analysis/pending/FFT/enhanced/recurrent buffers; multiple-hop concatenate and pending.copy remain unchanged.

Only the single-chunk final copy is removed. Hop ordering, recurrent ping-pong, empty latency, __call__/flush validation and counters are unchanged. After removing the new direct-return branch, the override matches the pinned base _consume AST.

All non-feed automatic-capture AST, read/finish/close/diagnostics paths remain unchanged. The test drives real _read cleanup/take/AudioRef using fake process/timer and synchronous cancellation in classification. It does not prove concurrent worker/IPC or physical microphone ownership.
